sources: One load (washing, boiling, rinsing) about 50 gallons of water; per year a housewife walked about 148 miles toting water and carried over 36 tons. Digital History, University of Houston, 'Private Life', based on Susan Strasser, Never Done: A History of American Housework (1982).
Wash day Monday, ironing Tuesday with sad irons heated on the stove: traditional household routine (Strasser 1982). Anna is illustrative.
Film: Lumière, 'Laveuses sur la rivière' (1897), public domain, illustrative (Internet Archive).
